svg.title: Lhotse — mountain relief
svg.desc: South face from Chukhung Ri. Lhotse, Lhotse Middle and Lhotse Shar, fluted rock walls and hanging glaciers. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Uwe Gille. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lhotse-fromChukhungRi.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
